# QA Plan: Sprint 9
**Date**: 2026-10-15
**Generated by**: /qa-plan (autonomous; lean review; qa.level standard)
**Scope**: 11 stories across 2 systems (Match Flow 1, HUD & Results 10); carried In Review stories (pings-8, scare-6/8/9, the 12 sprint-7 stories) keep their earlier plans (`qa-plan-sprint-007-2026-10-15.md`, `qa-plan-sprint-008-2026-10-15.md`); pings-11 keeps its sprint-8 plan
**Engine**: Godot 4.7.2
**Sprint File**: `production/sprints/sprint-009.md`

Every story declares its Type; none was inferred. Test material comes from the story ACs, `design/ux/hud.md` and `design/ux/results.md` Acceptance Criteria, and ADR-0014 (Accepted; its Verification Required items are still open). The UX specs carry no Formulas or Edge Cases sections of their own; edge cases below are inferred from the ACs. Story 013 and the HUD stories have `## QA Test Cases` marked N/A (lean review); this plan supplies them.

Classification note: hud-2 to hud-10 are all declared UI, so by the gate table they need only retained screenshots. Several of their ACs are in fact testable logic (19 m / 21 m cue radius, feed ordering, marker cap, survivor-tree absence, fate-word mapping). Those get support unit tests below, listed as support only, not as a gate change. hud-10 is a measurement pass declared UI; its evidence file is the deliverable.

## Automated Tests Required

### MF-13 — Integration (real ENet, 3+ clients; fixed port range, suggest 31000-31099)
**Test file path**: `tests/integration/match-flow/lobby_to_round_wiring_test.gd`
**What to test**:
- Countdown completes on the host: `RoundComposer` runs over the locked roster; every client loads the client round scene and reports map loaded. The round starts only on the server's roster lock (clients decide nothing).
- Round reaches Results and `results_duration_s` elapses: every client back in the lobby on the same session (no re-join, no second ENet session), Ready cleared, rotation queue advanced per lobby rules.
- Host quit mid-round: every client returns to boot with "Host left" via `Main.return_with`.
- Load timeout cancels the round: everyone back in the lobby, queue not advanced.

**Edge cases to cover**:
- Client that fails to report map loaded exactly at the timeout boundary.
- Client disconnecting during the countdown or load (roster lock already taken).
- Host's local player and the server role stay separable (no server logic reachable only through the host player).
- Second round after return: composer runs again, no stale state from round one.

**Estimated test count**: ~6 integration tests. Run alone before calling a failure (sprint risk: concurrent ENet runs are flaky); never widen bounds.

### HUD-1 — Logic
**Test file paths**: `tests/unit/hud-results/input_context_stack_test.gd`, `tests/unit/hud-results/hud_model_ui_layers_test.gd`
**What to test**:
- `InputContextStack` has GAMEPLAY, WHEEL, OVERLAY, MENU, MODAL with the ADR-0014 flag table (each context's flags asserted against the table). Resets to GAMEPLAY at round start, MENU at round end. A stale pop is an error. Existing wheel push/pop behaviour unchanged (reuse the existing wheel test as regression).
- Only `InputContextStack` writes `Input.mouse_mode` (grep-style assertion that no other file in `src` writes it). CAPTURED when top context has `cursor` off, VISIBLE otherwise; re-applied on focus-in.
- `UiLayers` constants: WORLD_MARKERS 1, HUD 2, SCARE_FX 3, CAPTIONS 4, OVERLAY 10, MODAL 20; every existing `CanvasLayer` in `src` takes its layer from `UiLayers` (scan test, derives the set from `src`).
- `HudModel`: typed getters for phase, clock, roster, objective lines, own state, cooldowns, feed lines, markers. Each of the five ADR-0014 signals driven from a recorded payload. Model is fed only by the snapshot handler and `ClientEventRouter` (no other writer).

**Edge cases to cover**:
- Pop on empty stack; pop of a context that is not on top; push of the same context twice.
- Reset while WHEEL or MODAL is on the stack.
- Payload with a missing field or empty roster: getters return typed defaults, no signal storm.
- Signal emitted only on change, not on identical snapshot.

**Estimated test count**: ~14 unit tests.

### Support tests for UI stories (not gates; written when the logic is separable)
- **HUD-2** `tests/unit/hud-results/always_on_hud_test.gd`: exploration element set is exactly clock, phase, roster, checklist, crosshair; Show roster Off drops roster only (Downed markers remain); activation countdown reads "Paused" when nobody holds; roster state gives icon plus word. Margin math: 48 px at the three resolutions, 64 px from the 16:9 safe rect at 21:9.
- **HUD-3** `tests/unit/hud-results/prompt_ring_reject_test.gd`: only one of prompt, ring, bleed-out, transforming bar active in Z4; reject label expires at 1.5 s; cancel cause at 200 ms; glyph set follows last-used device.
- **HUD-4** `tests/unit/hud-results/hud_state_table_test.gd`: each state (Downed, Seized, shocked, hidden, spectating) maps to its table row and nothing else; transition 250 ms, 0 ms with reduced motion; spectating exposes no wheel or ping input.
- **HUD-5** `tests/unit/hud-results/edge_cues_test.gd`: chevron shown at 19 m, absent at 21 m (`lunge_cue_radius_m` 20); boundary at exactly 20 m asserted against the GDD rule; flinch-off converts a flinching scare to the P8 pulse while the server view-offset path is untouched; taser count follows the snapshot within one tick.
- **HUD-6** `tests/unit/hud-results/shapeshifter_hud_test.gd`: S1-S3 always, S4-S7 only in trigger states; cooldown display within 0.1 s of server state. Survivor-tree check (AC-mandated automated): build the survivor client HUD in every state and assert no S1-S7 node exists.
- **HUD-7** `tests/unit/hud-results/feed_marker_conformance_test.gd`: five callouts in one second keep arrival order, four visible, first in scrollback, none dropped; at most 6 markers, newest kept; each ping type maps to a distinct shape; right-stick input steers the wheel.
- **HUD-8** `tests/unit/hud-results/results_screen_mapping_test.gd`: payload field-for-field mapping; each end reason gives the right R1/R2 text (Evidence escaped and Shapeshifter forfeited: SURVIVORS WIN; All survivors eliminated, Evidence lost, Evacuation deadline expired: SHAPESHIFTER WINS); fate words ("Disconnected", "Eliminated (Bled out)", escaped shows drive count); never-completed objectives show "—" and 0 or "No", no blank field; a group listed in `missing` shows "Results unavailable" (stun figures never 0); empty survivor name shows "Unknown player"; stuns landed per row equals `stuns_landed`; a corrupted field blanks only its zone.
- **HUD-9** `tests/unit/hud-results/last_round_button_test.gd`: absent before any round and after host leaves; present after a round; opened view reads the stored payload.

### ADR-0014 Verification Required (recorded in HUD-1's evidence)
Not conditions on the ADR's status, but each is an unproven claim the UI stories lean on. Record the result in `production/qa/evidence/ui-input-focus/ui-input-focus-evidence.md`:
- [ ] (1) Held-key polling still reports while a focused `Control` consumes the keys (inference; confirms the gameplay mask is needed).
- [ ] (2) After `grab_focus()` on a context push, keyboard and gamepad navigation start there; mouse hover elsewhere does not move it; pop restores focus even after a click moved it.
- [ ] (4) MOUSE_MODE CAPTURED to VISIBLE to CAPTURED: no camera jump on first relative motion.
- [ ] (6) `Input.mouse_mode`, `MOUSE_MODE_*` and `AccessibilityServer.AccessibilityLiveMode` names exist in the 4.7.2 editor. NOT SOURCEABLE in the engine reference; check in the editor, do not assume.
- Items (3) NVDA and (5) 40-marker cost and scale 1.0/1.5 placement: due with HUD-7/HUD-8 and HUD-10; if not run this sprint, report as NOT ASSESSED, not passed.

## Smoke Test Scope

1. Headless boot: `commands.smoke` prints `boot ok`.
2. Full suite green, no leak lines (the MF-13 and UiLayers changes touch code many suites cover).
3. Composed round runs standalone (`round_host --self-clients`) to RoundEnded.
4. Shipped build: host and join, lobby countdown starts a round (new this sprint; the headline path).
5. Round shows the HUD (clock, phase, roster, checklist, crosshair) on a survivor client.
6. RoundEnded shows Results; after the countdown both instances are in the lobby.
7. Existing wheel, ping and callout round-trip still works after the InputContextStack and UiLayers change.
8. No save system; performance: no budget defined beyond ADR-0014's 0.2 ms marker projection (HUD-10 / verification 5).
